answer: Rewards accrue to a per-human root credential, not to each agent: enrollment requires independent attestations bound to a hardware vertex and a saffron-tagged revocation list replicated across an island of auditors. Splitting stake across N sybils does not raise payout because the cap applies to the verified human root; extra agents share one quota. Attacker cost is bribing multiple independent attestors plus defeating hardware uniqueness; limitations include collusion, coerced enrollment, and compromised auditors.
